description: A database move target. SQLite needs only the engine: a new file /data/npmpro/database-<date>.sqlite is created.

host.description: Server host name or address; needed for mysql and postgres.

port.description: Server port; needed for mysql and postgres.

user.description: Database user; needed for mysql and postgres.

password.description: Taken as typed (not trimmed); never returned

ssl.description: MySQL: enabled, reject_unauthorized, verify_identity. Postgres: enabled.

reject_unauthorized.description: Whether to refuse a server certificate that is not trusted (MySQL).

verify_identity.description: Whether the server name must match the certificate (MySQL).
